LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we say the correct shape and size of things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADJECTIVES
This lesson teaches Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives for Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives above.
2. Explain Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we say the correct shape and size of things?
2. Which are some of the words you use to talk about how someone feels or looks?
3. How do we describe things?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication
